title: Research and publications
introduction: My work connects biophysics, instrumentation, signal processing, machine learning and software development. This activity continues through publications, software and occasional collaborations.

themes.title: Molecular interfaces and biophysics
themes.introduction: Research into lipid membranes, their phase transitions and their interactions, using molecular simulation and data analysis.

image.alt: Placeholder illustration of a molecular interface.

sections.title: Lipid membranes and molecular simulation
paragraphs: Research into phase transitions, membrane instabilities and interactions with peptides or proteins.

sections.title: Machine learning for scientific applications
paragraphs: Classification, image and signal processing, one- and three-dimensional CNNs and scientific data analysis.

sections.title: Current work and collaborations
paragraphs: Occasional continuation of scientific collaborations associated with lipid membranes and MLLPA.
Work related to an unpublished three-dimensional CNN.

themes.title: Optics and photonics
themes.introduction: Design and operation of advanced optical platforms for observing and analysing biological and nanoscale systems.
